profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The name, photo and contact details we show across Qeet ID.

picture.label: Profile picture
picture.help: PNG or JPG; a square image works best. Applied when you save.
picture.errorProcess: Couldn't process that image — try a different file.

profile.displayNamePlaceholder: How you'd like to be addressed
profile.emailHelp: Change your email from the security tab — it requires re-verification.

security.title: Security
security.description: Password, two-factor authentication, and active sessions for your account.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a strong, unique password. We recommend a password manager.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Faster, phishing-resistant sign-in using Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, or a security key.
passkeys.nameHint: Leave it empty to name it after this browser. You can rename it later.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey wasn't created. You can try again.
passkeys.disabled: Your organization has turned off passkeys, so you can't add one.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Add a second factor (authenticator app, SMS, or email code) to require a second step on every sign-in.

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.description: Social and identity providers linked to your account. You can sign in with any of them; unlink the ones you no longer use.
connected.empty: No connected accounts. Link one by signing in with a provider from the sign-in screen.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: All devices and browsers currently signed in to your account. Revoke any you don't recognise.

active.title: Active sessions
active.description: Every place you're currently signed in. Revoke any session you don't recognise.

revoke.title: Revoke this session?
revoke.description: Whoever holds it will be signed out.
revoke.label: Revoke
revoke.selfHelp: Use the sign-out menu to end the session you're currently using.

revokeAll.title: Sign out all other sessions?
revokeAll.description: Every session except this one ends and can no longer be renewed, including any not listed here. A device that is signed in may keep access for a few more minutes, until its current access runs out. You stay signed in here.
revokeAll.label: Sign out other sessions

toast.doneDescription: They can no longer renew their access. Access they already hold runs out within a few minutes.
toast.none: There were no other sessions to sign out
toast.failed: Couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try again.

signOutEverywhere.title: Sign out everywhere
signOutEverywhere.description: Lost a device? End every sign-in at once: this session, your other devices, the Qeet ID sign-in page in any browser, and the apps you signed in to with this account.

confirm.title: Sign out everywhere?
confirm.description: Every session ends, this one included, and none can be renewed: your devices, the Qeet ID sign-in page in any browser, and the apps you signed in to with this account. A device or app that is signed in may keep access for a few more minutes, until its current access runs out. You will need to sign in again.
confirm.label: Sign out everywhere

toast.doneDescription: None of them can be renewed. Access a device or app already holds runs out within a few minutes.
toast.failed: Couldn't sign you out everywhere. You are still signed in here; try again.

data.title: Data
data.description: Export or delete your personal data.

export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download a JSON archive of the personal data we hold about your account — profile, sessions, passkeys, and organization roles.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Permanently erases your personal data (email, name, phone) and sign-in credentials, and signs you out right away. Audit-log references are kept with PII redacted so administrators can still verify historical events. This can't be undone.

confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.description: This permanently erases your personal data and signs you out immediately. It can't be undone.
confirm.label: Delete my account
